name: PKSHA Technology Inc.
summary: PKSHA Technology Inc. develops algorithmic solutions. The company offers text comprehension module to understand the meaning of text data; HRUS, an area-specific image/video recognition engine that uses deep learning technology; and BEDORE, a general-purpose dialogue engine, which uses natural language processing technology. It also provides CELLOR, a CRM solution that emphasizes selling; and PREDICO, a prediction and inference engine. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
